purpose: Time-frozen preseason projection sources eligible or under review for FSFFL historical calibration. This inventory stores provenance only; it does not assert predictive superiority.
eligibility_rule: A snapshot must be demonstrably published no later than the opening date of the NFL regular season for that season. Same-day snapshots are flagged for manual time-of-day review before authoritative use. A retrieval mechanism that returns historical season projections is not sufficient by itself: the historical values must also be shown to represent a contemporaneous preseason snapshot rather than a mutable or reconstructed response.

position_expansion.rule: Each position-season must be independently verified from its displayed update date before admission.

remaining_requirement: A clean single-source native-vs-FFToday benchmark can now cover multiple positions and seasons, but source/blend calibration still requires at least one second independent source with comparable demonstrably time-frozen preseason snapshots.
